Forecast scope and output.question: What counts as a service need and who sets the tier
Forecast scope and output.answer: Three sources: (1) host/service failure (ping host DOWN, TCP port, monitored systemd/Windows service) with an operator-set tier per host and per service; (2) trend to threshold for disk fill, SSD/NVMe wear, reallocated sectors, memory creep, tier by days-to-threshold bands; (3) sustained or already-breached (disk already critical, CPU ~100% most of the time) = immediate. Case 3 is a new rule type (sustained breach), not regression.

Forecast scope and output.question: Trend bands and horizon
Forecast scope and output.answer: immediate: already critical or under 3 days; urgent: 3 to 20 days; standard: over 20 days; nothing shown beyond 90 days; all configurable (updates D-34 defaults of 3/15)

Forecast scope and output.question: Confidence tag
Forecast scope and output.answer: low <14 days history, medium 14-60 days, high >60 days with good straight-line fit; noisy/flat/away-from-threshold series gets no date ('stable' / 'no clear trend'); a low-confidence SMART/wear date is never immediate on its own
